retrievalProfile.description: A warm, moody Americana layout featuring a central photographic window framed by a heavy leather-textured border and bold, interlocking slab-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central photographic scene of a man in a dimly lit bar with a glowing jukebox, encased in a dark brown, leather-textured frame with visible perimeter stitching and vibrant orange-amber typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The glowing jukebox provides a secondary light source that contrasts with the warm amber key light on the subject.
The heavy leather frame creates a 'window' effect, focusing all attention on the central portrait.
The interlocking letters of the main title create a cohesive unit that balances the visual weight of the frame's top section.
The orange-amber text color directly pulls from the warm highlights in the photograph.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant of the central photo, scaled to a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold title at the top center acts as the primary anchor, followed by the glowing jukebox on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright title, moves down to the glowing jukebox, across to the subject's face, and finally to the footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The thick leather border serves as functional negative space, containing the primary and secondary text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-value, high-saturation warm tones create a cozy, nocturnal atmosphere.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens except as small accents in the jukebox.
Maintain a sepia-adjacent warmth throughout the image.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with western influence
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bars extending to connect letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'A' in the top line are tucked into one another
The 'S' and 'H' in the second line share a vertical boundary
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, custom-modified slab serif for the title paired with a clean, functional sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab-serif foundation needed for the title.
Suitable for the clean, wide-tracked footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph of a man in a dark, rustic bar with a glowing vintage jukebox (magenta/cyan lights) and warm amber lighting. Place this photo inside a larger dark brown leather-textured frame with a stitched border detail.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy, interlocking orange slab-serif font at the top. Add a secondary line of text in a clean, wide-tracked orange sans-serif at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the leather texture visible in the frame?
Does the title text overlap or interlock?
Is the lighting in the photo warm and moody?
Is the stitched border present around the perimeter?

mustRedesign: Any branded logos on the jukebox
Specific background artwork in the bar
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange text is legible against the dark brown.
Verify the 'window' effect of the central photo.
Check that the stitching looks like a physical detail.
Confirm the interlocking letters don't lose legibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Leather Frame + Stitched Border + Warm Bar Photography + Interlocking Slab-Serif Title
